description: This PHP class 'AttributeResponse' extends 'MetaResponse' and is responsible for managing attribute responses in a JSON API context. It validates that the provided attribute data does not include forbidden keys such as 'relationships' and 'links'.

classes.name: AttributeResponse
classes.description: A PHP class for handling JSON API attribute responses with validation for forbidden keys.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the response object and checks for forbidden keys in properties.
